content.content:
#### Opening

At each launch, Suspense runs the checks in the background as it starts. If any required check fails, the welcome page opens over the main window once they are done, unless the user has turned off "Show at launch when something needs attention", a checkbox at the page's foot, on until turned off, remembered for the user. When every check passes, nothing is shown. It opens by itself at most once in a launch: once it has been closed, or the user has opened anything else in the inset panel meanwhile, nothing opens it again but the Welcome command, not checks run again, not a fix finishing, and not checks still failing.

#### Closing

The welcome page closes as any inset panel does, as the [InsetPanelScope](../../ui/components/inset-panel/index.md#inset-panel-scope) says: with its close button, its Get started button, <Escape>, or a click on the dimmed window around it, and always, whatever its checks say, failing, passing, or still running, and however it was opened. Closing it never waits on a check, nor on a fix still running, as setting up Podman, which carries on in the background, its check running again once it finishes without opening the page. Once it closes, focus goes back to the chat input, and everything beneath it works as it does with the page closed, what needs a failing check failing as it says it does.
It can be opened at any time with the Welcome command, a "Welcome" button with a checklist icon in a "Help" group, the last group of the [RibbonApplicationTabScope](../../ui/components/ribbon/application-tab/index.md#ribbon-application-tab-scope), after Preferences, whose tooltip says it checks that Suspense is ready to run. It is a full button, and not primary, so the collapsed ribbon leaves it out. Opening it runs every check anew. It needs no project, and works the same with or without one.

content.text:
The welcome page can now be closed. The bug was mine from the last change: the main window's close code didn't count the welcome page as an open panel.

- **Why it got stuck:** the close button, Escape and a click on the dimmed area all go through one shared close function. That function first checks whether a panel is open, and its list of panels didn't include the welcome page, so every close attempt did nothing. I added the welcome page to that list and to the related check further down the same function in `src/main_window.rs`. Closing it now works like Settings: it never waits on checks or a running Podman setup, and focus goes back to the chat input.
- **Opens by itself at most once per launch:** the launch checks could open the page only once already. I also made opening anything else in the panel before those checks finish cancel the automatic open. After that, only the Welcome command opens it; rechecks, a fix finishing, or checks still failing don't reopen it.

I added a test that closes the page each of the three ways while its checks are still running. It also checks that opening another panel first stops the launch checks from opening the page later. All 495 tests pass; I didn't try it in the running app.
